Method of Attack: Remote code execution allowing arbitrary file upload and execution
Subscriber-level user registration bypass to exploit Elementor Pro vulnerability
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Elementor Pro plugin
WordPress websites using Ultimate Addons for Elementor plugin
Attack Vector: Registered user access to upload and execute arbitrary files
Exploitation of subscriber-level user registration bypass even if user registration is disabled
Indicators of Compromise: Unknown files or folders in /wp-content/uploads/elementor/custom-icons/ directory
